nodes.name: glass cruet
nodes.caption: A transparent glass cruet with a bulbous body, narrow neck, and wooden spherical stopper; it contains amber-colored liquid (likely olive oil) with a small yellow droplet visible inside, and features a small glass handle on the side. The bottle sits upright on a wooden plank surface.

nodes.name: glass cruet
nodes.caption: A transparent glass cruet identical in shape to the oil bottle, filled with dark opaque liquid (likely balsamic vinegar), topped with a matching wooden spherical stopper and small glass handle; the surface shows subtle condensation or texture. It rests directly on the wooden floor.

nodes.name: wooden mortar
nodes.caption: A rustic wooden mortar with visible grain and slightly tapered cylindrical shape, containing green chives and a wooden pestle partially inserted; the rim is smooth and the exterior has a warm brown finish. It sits directly on the wooden floor.

nodes.name: mint sprig
nodes.caption: A fresh sprig of mint with five ovate leaves showing variegated light-green and pale-yellow edges, glossy surface, and prominent veins; the stem is thin and green, lying flat on the wooden surface near other ingredients. It is not supported by any object—resting directly on the floor.

nodes.name: garlic bulb
nodes.caption: A whole garlic bulb with papery white outer skin, slightly irregular ovoid shape, and visible cloves beneath translucent layers; it lies on its side next to the oil bottle on the wooden floor. No attachment to other objects.
